senses.gloss: coffee (beverage made by infusing the beans of the coffee plant in hot water)
coffee (any plant of the genus Coffea)
coffee (seeds of the plant used to make coffee, called “beans” due to their shape)
coffee-like beverage made from grains, seeds, or roots of various plants
coffee (short social gathering where coffee is served)
jackdaw (any corvid of the genus Coloeus)
tree roof (roof supported by pillars as a display in front of a house for setting a tree)

etymologies.text: Internationalism; compare Hungarian kávé, Serbo-Croatian kava, Turkish kahve, ultimately from Ottoman Turkish قهوه (kahve). Doublet of café.
